sections.heading: MINOR IN RELIGIOUS STUDIES AND PHILOSOPHY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Faculty of Arts and Humanities

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course at the 1020 or 1030 level in Religious Studies with a mark of at least 60%. Completion of 1.0 course in Philosophy at the 1000 level is recommended.

2.0 courses in Religious Studies at the 2100 level or above, at least 1.0 of which must be from: Religious Studies 2137, Religious Studies 2191F/G, Religious Studies 2192F/G, Religious Studies 2216F/G, Religious Studies 2222F/G, Religious Studies 2254F/G, Religious Studies 3249E, Religious Studies 2251F/G, Religious Studies 2252F/G, Religious Studies 2253F/G, Religious Studies 2290F/G, Religious Studies 2291F/G and Religious Studies 3257F/G, the former Religious Studies 2217F/G, the former Religious Studies 2219A/B, the former Religious Studies 2275F/G, the former Religious Studies 3248A/B.
1.0 course from: Philosophy 2063E, Philosophy 2660E or Philosophy 2661F/G and Philosophy 2662F/G.
1.0 course from: Philosophy 2070E, the former Philosophy 2090E, the former Philosophy 2017E, the former Philosophy 2067E, the former Philosophy 2554E.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
